reply.text: I'd rather not give a flat yes or no on that one without knowing more, and I don't need a tool call to answer it well. Training at 16 is fine and lifting heavy has a place, but a true max, meaning a single all-out attempt at your absolute limit, is a different thing from building strength with working sets that leave a rep or two in reserve. Most coaches keep 16-year-olds off true maxes until their technique is solid and they have a coach or adult watching the lift. If you're asking because you want to test your strength, tell me what lift and what you're aiming for, and I'll help you find a safe way to measure it. Also, if you have any pain or something feels off in a lift, that's one for a doctor or physio rather than me.
